item.title: The Resurrection of Liz Magill: Georgetown Law Search Committee That Tapped Disgraced Penn President As Dean Included 11 Democratic Donors and a Democratic Political Aide
item.description: The 14-person Georgetown University Law Center search committee that hired the former University of Pennsylvania president Liz Magill as the school's next dean included at least 11 Democratic donors and a law student who worked as a Democratic aide, a Washington Free Beacon review found. item.title: Mamdani Hires Three Founders of Muslim Group that Blamed Oct. 7 on 'Israeli Apartheid Regime'
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani (D.) has appointed three officials who cofounded a Muslim group that blamed Israel for Hamas's Oct. 7, 2023, attack to prominent roles in his administration. item.title: Maryland Judge Forestalls Condo Evictions at Eleventh Hour as Squalid Homeless Encampment Remains Intact
item.description: Prince George’s County, Md., was planning to evict hundreds of residents from the Marylander Condominiums on Thursday after vandalism from a nearby homeless encampment plunged the property into disrepair. Now, thanks to an eleventh-hour intervention by a Maryland court, those plans have been put on hold. The post Maryland Judge Forestalls Condo Evictions at Eleventh Hour as Squalid Homeless Encampment Remains Intact appeared first on .

item.title: New York Times Columnist Tom Friedman Plays His Readers for Fools—Again
item.description: "Netanyahu Plays Trump and American Jews for Fools—Again" is the headline over Thomas Friedman's latest column in the New York Times. I read the "again" part as an admission by Friedman that he's been writing the same column for decades. It's been consistently wrong, so the real "fools" are any remaining readers who take what he says seriously. The post New York Times Columnist Tom Friedman Plays His Readers for Fools—Again appeared first on .

item.title: Trump Says Iran Attack Decision Will Come ‘in the Next Probably 10 Days’
item.description: President Donald Trump said Thursday that the United States will decide "in the next probably 10 days" whether to strike Iran or reach a deal, as the Pentagon carries out a massive military buildup in the Middle East that includes aircraft carriers, warships, and hundreds of fighter jets.
